title: 第十章萧书生大战鬼手门喽啰二第九章鬼手门掌门出手一
content_zh:
“先生，你看，那是不是‘灵草’？”一个名叫李明的学子指着不远处的一片草丛，兴奋地喊道。
萧琰顺着李明指的方向望去，只见草丛中生长着几株绿油油的草药，叶片呈椭圆形，叶片边缘还有着细小的锯齿，正是他要找的“灵草”。他心中一喜，连忙说道：“没错，这就是‘灵草’。大家小心一点，不要伤到草药的根部。”
就在学子们小心翼翼地采摘“灵草”时，萧琰突然听到一阵细微的脚步声。他心中一动，示意学子们停止采摘，警惕地向四周望去。只见不远处的树林中，十几个黑衣汉子正鬼鬼祟祟地向他们靠近，正是“鬼手门”的喽啰们。
“先生，是‘鬼手门’的人！”李明吓得脸色发白，声音都有些颤抖。
萧琰拍了拍李明的肩膀，安慰道：“不要怕，有先生在。大家听我指挥，一会儿我来对付他们，你们趁机向山下跑，去找官府的人来帮忙。”
“可是先生，我们走了，你一个人怎么对付他们？”另一个学子担忧地说道。
“放心吧，先生自有办法。”萧琰眼神坚定，他知道，现在不是犹豫的时候，必须尽快让学子们离开，否则他们都会有危险。
说罢，萧琰从怀中掏出几个机关兽，扔到地上。那些机关兽落地后，瞬间变成了几只凶猛的老虎，虎视眈眈地盯着“鬼手门”的喽啰们。“鬼手门”的喽啰们见状，吓得停下了脚步，不敢再向前靠近。
为首的黑衣汉子正是上次在“断云巷”被萧琰击退的那个，他看着眼前的机关老虎，眼中闪过一丝忌惮，但一想到《墨玄经》的诱惑，他又咬牙道：“弟兄们，不要怕！这只是些假老虎，看我怎么收拾它们！”
说罢，他从怀中掏出一把弯刀，向一只机关老虎砍去。“哐当”一声，弯刀砍在机关老虎的身上，发出一声清脆的响声，机关老虎却丝毫未损。为首的黑衣汉子心中一惊，他没想到这些机关老虎竟如此坚硬。
就在为首的黑衣汉子愣神之际，萧琰突然向他冲了过去，手中的短匕直逼他的咽喉。为首的黑衣汉子反应过来，急忙挥舞着弯刀格挡。两人你来我往，打得不可开交。
其余的“鬼手门”喽啰们见状，也纷纷向萧琰扑来。萧琰毫不畏惧，他一边与为首的黑衣汉子缠斗，一边操控着机关老虎攻击其他的喽啰们。机关老虎凶猛异常，一口便咬住了一个喽啰的手臂，疼得那个喽啰哇哇大叫。
“弟兄们，用毒针！”为首的黑衣汉子大喊道。
喽啰们闻言，纷纷从怀中掏出黑色的竹筒，对准萧琰和机关老虎发射毒针。萧琰早有防备，他迅速从怀中掏出一块盾牌，挡在身前，同时操控着机关老虎向喽啰们冲去。毒针打在盾牌上，发出“叮叮当当”的声响，却无法穿透盾牌。
机关老虎冲到喽啰们面前，张开大嘴，露出锋利的牙齿，吓得喽啰们纷纷向后退去。萧琰趁机向前一跃，手中的短匕向为首的黑衣汉子刺去。为首的黑衣汉子急忙向后躲闪，却还是被短匕划破了手臂，鲜血瞬间流了出来。
“啊！”为首的黑衣汉子疼得大叫一声，他没想到萧琰的武功竟如此厉害。他知道，再这样打下去，自己和弟兄们都会吃亏，于是他大喊道：“弟兄们，撤！”
说罢，他便带着其余的喽啰们向山林深处逃去。萧琰本想追上去，但想到学子们的安全，他还是停下了脚步。他看着喽啰们逃走的方向，心中暗道：“这些‘鬼手门’的喽啰真是阴魂不散，看来我必须尽快想办法彻底解决他们。”
随后，萧琰带着学子们拿着采摘好的“灵草”，匆匆向山下走去。一路上，学子们都对萧琰充满了敬佩，纷纷称赞他英勇无畏。萧琰只是笑了笑，他知道，这只是暂时的胜利，“鬼手门”的人绝不会就此罢休。
回到“静云书院”后，萧琰将学子们安全带回的消息告知了书院的师生们，师生们都松了一口气。随后，他将采摘来的“灵草”交给了书院的医官，让医官为患上风寒的学子们熬药。
当晚，萧琰在书房中翻阅《墨玄经》，希望能从中找到对付“鬼手门”的方法。他发现，《墨玄经》中记载了一种名为“墨玄阵”的阵法，此阵法威力无穷，若能布下此阵，定能将“鬼手门”的喽啰们一网打尽。

但要布下“墨玄阵”，需要用到大量的机关和药材，还需要有足够的人手协助。萧琰心中盘算着，他决定明日便去官府，向官府大人求助，希望官府能派人与他一同布下“墨玄阵”，围剿“鬼手门”的喽啰们。
次日清晨，萧琰早早地便来到了官府。他向官府大人详细说明了“墨玄阵”的威力和布阵所需的条件，希望官府大人能派人与他一同布阵。官府大人闻言，当即表示同意，他说道：“萧先生，剿灭‘鬼手门’是我们官府的职责，我们定会全力配合你。你需要什么，尽管开口，我们一定尽力满足。”
随后，官府大人派了一百名官兵跟随萧琰前往山林中布阵。萧琰带着官兵们在山林中寻找合适的布阵地点，最终将地点选在了一处山谷中。这处山谷地势险要，易守难攻，非常适合布下“墨玄阵”。
接下来的几日，萧琰带领着官兵们在山谷中布置“墨玄阵”。他先在山谷的入口处设置了大量的机关陷阱，然后在山谷中摆放了许多机关兽和暗器发射器，最后又在山谷的四周种植了一些含有剧毒的草药，一旦有人进入山谷，便会触发机关陷阱，遭到机关兽和暗器的攻击，还会吸入草药散发的毒气，中毒身亡。
经过几日的努力，“墨玄阵”终于布置完成。萧琰看着自己的杰作，心中充满了信心。他知道，只要“鬼手门”的喽啰们进入山谷，便再也无法逃脱。
两百余名“鬼手门”喽啰在为首汉子的带领下，气势汹汹地冲向山谷。他们踩着清晨的露水，手中的兵器在朝阳下泛着冷光，眼中满是对《墨玄经》的贪婪，全然没察觉死亡的阴影已悄然笼罩。
“大哥，你说那萧书生真在谷里修炼？会不会是陷阱啊？”一名瘦高个喽啰缩了缩脖子，望着幽深的山谷入口，心底莫名发怵。
为首汉子啐了一口，挥了挥手中染过血的鬼头刀：“怕个屁！上次是咱们轻敌，这次带了这么多弟兄，就算他有机关，也能踏平这破山谷！等拿到《墨玄经》，咱们兄弟就能飞黄腾达，到时候谁还敢小瞧咱们‘鬼手门’！”
喽啰们被这话点燃了贪欲，纷纷吆喝着冲进山谷。可刚踏入谷口，脚下突然传来“咔嗒”一声轻响——是萧琰布下的“连环绊索”机关。
“不好！”为首汉子心中一紧，可已经晚了。两侧山壁上突然弹出数十根削尖的木刺，如暴雨般射向人群。
“啊！我的腿！”
“救命！我中刺了！”
惨叫声瞬间响彻山谷，十几个喽啰应声倒地，鲜血顺着木刺滴落，染红了脚下的碎石。其余喽啰吓得连连后退，脸上的嚣张荡然无存。
萧琰站在山谷深处的巨石上，透过树叶的缝隙观察着这一切。他指尖捏着一枚青铜哨子，见喽啰们陷入慌乱，便轻轻吹响。哨声尖锐，穿透山谷，紧接着，谷中突然升起浓密的淡绿色雾气——那是他用“腐心草”和“迷魂花”炼制的毒雾，吸入者会头晕目眩，四肢无力。
“快捂住口鼻！是毒雾！”为首汉子反应极快，急忙掏出随身携带的麻布，捂住自己和身边喽啰的口鼻。可大部分喽啰来不及防备，吸入毒雾后便摇摇晃晃地倒在地上，手中的兵器“哐当”落地。
萧琰见状，纵身跃下巨石，手中握着一把由墨家机关改造的“连弩”——这连弩一次可发射十支铁箭，箭头上还涂了麻痹毒素。他对准人群中的为首汉子，扣动扳机，十支铁箭如流星般射出。
content_en:
"Sir, look, is that a 'spiritual grass'?" A student named Li Ming pointed to a patch of grass not far away and shouted excitedly.
Xiao Yan looked in the direction pointed by Li Ming and saw several green herbs growing in the grass. The leaves were oval and there were tiny serrations on the edges of the leaves. They were the "spiritual herbs" he was looking for. He was overjoyed and said quickly: "Yes, this is the 'Spiritual Grass'. Everyone, be careful not to hurt the roots of the herb."
Just as the students were carefully picking the "spiritual grass", Xiao Yan suddenly heard a faint sound of footsteps. With a thought in his heart, he signaled the students to stop picking and looked around cautiously. In the woods not far away, they saw a dozen men in black approaching them furtively. They were the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect".
"Sir, he's from the Ghost Hand Sect!" Li Ming's face turned pale with fright, and his voice was trembling.
Xiao Yan patted Li Ming on the shoulder and said comfortingly: "Don't be afraid, sir is here. Everyone, listen to my instructions. I will deal with them later. You take the opportunity to run down the mountain and find people from the government to help."
"But sir, if we leave, how will you deal with them by yourself?" Another student said worriedly.
"Don't worry, sir, you have your own way." Xiao Yan's eyes were firm. He knew that now was not the time to hesitate. The students must leave as soon as possible, otherwise they would all be in danger.
After saying that, Xiao Yan took out a few machine beasts from his arms and threw them to the ground. After the machine beasts landed, they instantly turned into several ferocious tigers, staring at the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect" with eager eyes. When the gangsters of the "Ghost Hand Sect" saw this, they were so frightened that they stopped and did not dare to move any closer.
The man in black at the head was the one who was repulsed by Xiao Yan in "Duanyun Alley" last time. He looked at the trap tiger in front of him, a trace of fear flashed in his eyes, but when he thought of the temptation of "Mo Xuan Jing", he gritted his teeth and said: "Brothers, don't be afraid! These are just fake tigers, let's see how I deal with them!"
After that, he took out a machete from his arms and slashed at a trap tiger. With a "clang" sound, the machete struck the machine tiger's body, making a crisp sound, but the machine tiger was not damaged at all. The leading man in black was shocked. He didn't expect these trap tigers to be so hard.
Just as the leading man in black was stunned, Xiao Yan suddenly rushed towards him, with the dagger in his hand pointed at his throat. The leading man in black reacted and hurriedly waved his machete to block. The two of them were going back and forth, fighting fiercely.
When the other "Ghost Hand Sect" gangsters saw this, they also rushed towards Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan was not afraid. While fighting with the leading man in black, he controlled the machine tiger to attack the other minions. The trap tiger was so ferocious that it bit the arm of a minion in one bite, causing the minion to scream in pain.
"Brothers, use poisonous needles!" the leading man in black shouted.
Upon hearing this, the minions took out black bamboo tubes from their arms and fired poisonous needles at Xiao Yan and the trap tiger. Xiao Yan was already on guard. He quickly took out a shield from his arms and held it in front of him. At the same time, he controlled the machine tiger to rush towards the minions. The poisonous needle hit the shield, making a "dinging" sound, but it could not penetrate the shield.
The trap tiger rushed in front of the minions, opened its big mouth, and exposed its sharp teeth, which scared the minions and backed away. Xiao Yan took the opportunity to jump forward and stabbed the leading man in black with the dagger in his hand. The leading man in black hurriedly dodged back, but his arm was still cut open by the dagger, and blood flowed out instantly.
"Ah!" The leading man in black yelled in pain. He didn't expect Xiao Yan's martial arts to be so powerful. He knew that if he continued to fight like this, he and his brothers would suffer, so he shouted: "Brothers, withdraw!"
After that, he took the rest of the minions and fled deep into the forest. Xiao Yan wanted to catch up, but thinking about the safety of the students, he still stopped. He looked at the direction in which the minions were escaping, and thought to himself: "These 'Ghost Hand Sect' minions are really lingering. It seems that I must find a way to deal with them as soon as possible."
Afterwards, Xiao Yan led the students and hurried down the mountain with the picked "spiritual grass". Along the way, the students were full of admiration for Xiao Yan and praised him for his bravery and fearlessness. Xiao Yan just smiled. He knew that this was only a temporary victory, and the people of the "Ghost Hand Sect" would never give up.
After returning to "Jingyun Academy", Xiao Yan informed the teachers and students of the academy that the students had been brought back safely. The teachers and students all breathed a sigh of relief. Later, he handed the picked "spiritual grass" to the medical officer of the academy, and asked the medical officer to prepare medicine for the students suffering from cold.
That night, Xiao Yan read the "Mo Xuan Jing" in his study, hoping to find a way to deal with the "Ghost Hand Sect". He discovered that the "Mo Xuan Jing" records a formation called "Mo Xuan Formation". This formation is extremely powerful. If this formation can be deployed, the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect" will be wiped out in one fell swoop.
But to set up the "Mo Xuan Formation", a large number of mechanisms and medicinal materials are needed, as well as enough manpower to assist. Xiao Yan was thinking about it, and decided to go to the government tomorrow to ask for help, hoping that the government could send someone to set up the "Mo Xuan Formation" with him to surround and suppress the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect".
In the early morning of the next day, Xiao Yan came to the government office early. He explained the power of the "Mo Xuan Formation" and the conditions required for setting up the formation in detail to the government officials, hoping that the officials would send someone to join him in setting up the formation. Upon hearing this, the government officials immediately agreed. He said: "Mr. Xiao, it is our government's responsibility to destroy the 'Ghost Hand Sect', and we will fully cooperate with you. If you need anything, just ask, and we will try our best to satisfy you."
Subsequently, the government officials sent a hundred officers and soldiers to follow Xiao Yan to set up formations in the mountains and forests. Xiao Yan led his officers and soldiers to search for a suitable location for the formation in the mountains and forests, and finally chose the location in a valley. The terrain of this valley is dangerous, easy to defend and difficult to attack, so it is very suitable for setting up the "Moxuan Formation".
In the next few days, Xiao Yan led the officers and soldiers to set up the "Mo Xuan Formation" in the valley. He first set up a large number of traps at the entrance of the valley, then placed many trap beasts and hidden weapon launchers in the valley. Finally, he planted some highly toxic herbs around the valley. Once someone entered the valley, they would trigger the traps and be attacked by the trap beasts and hidden weapons. They would also inhale the poisonous gas emitted by the herbs and die of poisoning.
After several days of hard work, the "Mo Xuan Formation" was finally set up. Xiao Yan looked at his masterpiece and felt full of confidence. He knew that as long as the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect" entered the valley, they would never be able to escape.
More than two hundred "Ghost Hand Sect" minions, led by the leader, rushed toward the valley with great momentum. They stepped on the morning dew, the weapons in their hands glowed coldly in the morning sun, their eyes were full of greed for the "Mo Xuan Jing", and they were completely unaware that the shadow of death had quietly enveloped them.
"Brother, do you think that Scholar Xiao is really practicing in the valley? Is it a trap?" A tall and thin man shrank his neck and looked at the entrance of the deep valley, feeling inexplicably terrified.
The leading man spat and waved the blood-stained Ghost-headed Sword in his hand: "What a damn thing! Last time we underestimated the enemy, this time with so many brothers, even if he has a mechanism, he can conquer this broken valley! When we get the "Mo Xuan Jing", our brothers will be able to flourish. Then who will dare to underestimate our 'Ghost Hand Sect'!"
The minions were ignited with greed by these words, and rushed into the valley shouting. But as soon as he stepped into the valley entrance, there was a sudden "click" sound under his feet - it was the "serial trip wire" mechanism set up by Xiao Yan.
"Not good!" The leader's heart tightened, but it was already too late. Dozens of sharpened wooden thorns suddenly popped out from the mountain walls on both sides., shooting towards the crowd like a torrential rain.
"Ah! My legs!"
"Help! I've been stabbed!"
Screams instantly echoed through the valley, and more than a dozen minions fell to the ground. Blood dripped down the wooden thorns, dyeing the gravel under their feet red. The other minions were so frightened that they backed away, the arrogance on their faces gone.
Xiao Yan stood on a boulder deep in the valley, observing all this through the gaps in the leaves. He held a bronze whistle between his fingertips, and when he saw the minions were in panic, he blew it gently. The whistle was sharp, penetrating the valley, and then, a dense light green mist suddenly rose in the valley - it was the poisonous mist he refined with "Heart-rotten Grass" and "Ecstasy Flower". Those who inhaled it would be dizzy and weak in limbs.
"Hurry up and cover your mouth and nose! It's poisonous mist!" The leading man reacted very quickly. He hurriedly took out the linen he carried with him and covered his own mouth and nose and that of the minions around him. But most of the minions were too late to take precautions. After inhaling the poisonous mist, they staggered to the ground, and the weapons in their hands fell to the ground with a clang.
Upon seeing this, Xiao Yan jumped off the boulder, holding in his hand a "continuous crossbow" modified by the Mohist organization - this continuous crossbow can fire ten iron arrows at a time, and the arrows are also coated with paralyzing toxin. He aimed at the leading man in the crowd, pulled the trigger, and ten iron arrows shot out like meteors.
